questions.q: Who can use this platform?
questions.a: This platform is available to users with a UIUC Microsoft account, and community drivers that are not students but operate frequent routes to increase ride availability for the community. RideList does not perform background checks, license verification, or safety screening on any drivers. Community Driver is only a category label and does not imply endorsement, certification, or guarantee by the platform.

questions.q: Do I need to create a profile?
questions.a: A basic profile is created automatically when you sign in. You can edit your name and photo later if you choose.

questions.q: Is my real name visible to everyone?
questions.a: No. Your full name is only shown to people who are actively booking or riding with you. Public viewers see a redacted name.

questions.q: Do I need to add a car before posting a trip?
questions.a: Yes. Every trip must be associated with a car so riders know what to expect.

questions.q: Can I reuse trip or rule settings?
questions.a: Yes. You can save trip templates and rule templates to quickly post similar trips in the future.

questions.q: What does “Auto-accept” mean?
questions.a: If enabled, riders who meet your rules will be automatically accepted without manual approval.

questions.q: Can I edit trip details after riders join?
questions.a: Some fields can be edited before pickup starts. Once pickup begins, trip rules and car info are locked for records.

questions.q: Are exact pickup and drop-off addresses public?
questions.a: No. Public listings show general areas, not exact addresses.

questions.q: When are exact locations shared?
questions.a: Exact pickup details are only shared between drivers and riders during active coordination.

questions.q: Why can’t I see someone’s address yet?
questions.a: Location details unlock only when they are operationally needed (e.g., during check-in or pickup).

questions.q: How does search ranking work?
questions.a: Results are ranked using a combination of time proximity, pickup distance, and drop-off distance.

questions.q: Can I book multiple trips?
questions.a: Yes, but you can only have one active booking per trip.

questions.q: What happens after I request to join a trip?
questions.a:
Depending on the trip rules, you may be:

- auto-accepted
- waiting for driver approval
- given a payment window

questions.q: What payment methods are supported?
questions.a: Supported methods are listed on each trip. These may include cash or digital payment methods.

questions.q: What is a payment window?
questions.a: Some trips require payment within a set time. If payment isn’t confirmed in time, the booking may expire automatically.

questions.q: What happens if my payment times out?
questions.a: Your booking will be marked as expired, and the seat may be released.

questions.q: What is check-in?
questions.a: Check-in allows riders to mark themselves as ready for pickup.

questions.q: Can I change my pickup note during check-in?
questions.a: Yes, but changes are rate-limited to prevent spam.

questions.q: What happens when the driver starts pickup?
questions.a: Pickup begins, trip details are locked, and riders who are not picked up may be marked as no-shows.

questions.q: What happens if a driver is late?
questions.a:
The system may:

- send reminders
- automatically start pickup after a grace period

questions.q: What if a driver forgets to complete the trip?
questions.a: Trips may be automatically completed after a set amount of time.

questions.q: Can trips be cancelled after pickup starts?
questions.a: No. After pickup starts, trips can only be completed or aborted.

questions.q: What notifications will I receive?
questions.a: You’ll receive notifications for important events like booking updates, check-in, pickup start, trip changes, and direct messages.

questions.q: Can I turn off notifications?
questions.a: Non-critical notifications can be adjusted in your settings. Important notifications cannot be disabled.

questions.q: How do you prevent misuse?
questions.a:
We cannot prevent real-life safety issues. However, we designed the system with
- Limited data visibility
- Event logs for clarity 
- Automated privacy safeguards
Regardless, please be aware of your safety and use common sense when meeting people.

questions.q: Is my phone number public?
questions.a: No. Phone numbers are only shared temporarily during active trips or short grace periods afterward.

questions.q: Can I see past trips and bookings?
questions.a: Yes. Your trip and booking history is always available to you.

questions.q: Why can I still see someone’s name from a past trip?
questions.a: Past interactions act as a “receipt” so you know who you interacted with, but contact details are hidden.

questions.q: Is this a rideshare company?
questions.a: No. This platform helps students coordinate rides. Drivers and riders arrange details directly. We do not make any safety-related promises.

questions.q: Who do I contact if something goes wrong?
questions.a: Use the contact button in the footer for platform-related issues. For safety concerns, please contact the police.

about.title: About Us
about.description: Connecting the UIUC community with convenient, transparent rides.
about.content: RideList was built to solve the fragmentation of ride-sharing at UIUC. No more digging through Facebook groups or group chats. We provide a centralized, searchable, and easily usable platform for students to find and post rides.

intro.title: What This Platform Is
intro.description: This platform helps UIUC students coordinate rides in a transparent and structured way.
intro.note: This is not a traditional rideshare or taxi service. Drivers post trips they are already planning to take, and riders request to join those trips under clearly defined rules.
list: Create clear records of what happened

access.title: University students and community drivers
access.p1: Students who sign-in with UIUC Microsoft account can create an account and use the platform.
access.p2: Community drivers are non-UIUC users that operate frequent routes to increase ride availability for the community. They can only join upon platform manual approval, although RideList does not perform background checks, license verification, or safety screening on any drivers. Community Driver is only a category label and does not imply endorsement, certification, or guarantee by the platform.
access.p3: Ensuring everyone on the platform belongs to the same university community is important to us.

records.p2: Contact information automatically expires after trips end.

intro.title: Our goal
intro.p1: This platform is designed to help UIUC students coordinate rides conveniently, transparently, and with clear expectations. While no system can eliminate all risk, we’ve built the system with privacy and trip coordination as priority.

who.title: Who is allowed on this platform
who.p1: Users authenticated through UIUC Microsoft login can create an account, or community drivers that are non-UIUC with manual approval by the platform.
who.p2: Disclaimer: we do not screen or perform safety checks. Use caution when meeting people. RideList does not perform background checks, license verification, or safety screening on any drivers. Community Driver is only a category label and does not imply endorsement, certification, or guarantee by the platform.
who.link: Learn more about account creation in How it works → Getting started

identity.title: Identity & profile visibility
list: Full names, photos, and phone numbers are not public by default
Identity details become visible only when there is an active or recent trip relationship
Past trips do not grant permanent access to personal contact information
identity.p2: Your profile is not meant to be a public directory.
identity.link: See detailed profile visibility rules in How it works → Profiles & privacy

location.title: Location privacy
location.p1: Exact addresses are never publicly displayed.
list1: Public trip listings show general areas, not exact pickup points
list2: with users directly involved in the trip
location.p3: Latitude/longitude data is never exposed to unrelated users
location.p4: Drivers control pickup radii, not exact addresses.
location.link: See how location visibility works in How it works → Location handling

pickup.title: Pickup & meeting procedure
list: Pickup coordination opens only when it’s operationally necessary
Riders and drivers can share notes during active trips
You are never required to meet before a trip becomes active
If something feels wrong, you can leave or remove a booking before departure
pickup.p2: Trust your judgment and use common sense.

payments.title: Payments & financial expectations
payments.p1: This platform does not process payments.
list: Payments are arranged directly between riders and drivers
The system tracks payment status only to manage trip flow
No funds are held, escrowed, or guaranteed
payments.p2: Booking history and timestamps are preserved for clarity.
payments.link: Learn how booking statuses work in How it works → Booking lifecycle

automation.title: Automated protections
automation.p1: The system uses automation to reduce confusion and unfairness:
list: Seats are released if riders don’t pay within the allowed window
Trips are locked before departure to prevent last-minute chaos
Check-in, departure, and completion can be automated if forgotten
All system actions are logged and visible
automation.link: See system automation rules in How it works → System behavior

disputes.title: Disputes & disagreements
disputes.p1: This is a coordination platform, not an arbitration service.
list: Users are responsible for communication and decisions
The system preserves booking history and action timestamps
Repeated misuse becomes visible through patterns and records
disputes.p2: Use common sense and communicate early.

expectations.title: Community expectations
list: Be honest about timing and availability
Respect pickup rules and time windows
Treat others as you would want to be treated
expectations.p2: This platform works because the community does.

not.title: What this platform is not
not.p1: To avoid misunderstandings, this platform is not:

unsafe.title: If you feel unsafe
list: Do not proceed with a pickup if you feel uncomfortable
You are not obligated to continue a trip
Leaving a booking before departure is allowed
